Evergather: every item, categorized

Generated 2026-10-10 from the current Space game content. 838 unique item types; rarity variants count once. Includes the 38 starter tools stored outside the item metadata catalog.

Gathering drops come from Gather actions. Activity rewards come from Activities, including activities labeled Processing. Crafted items/equipment come from recipes that consume ingredients. These are separate acquisition routes.

“Gameplay use” means equipped as a tool or consumed by a recipe, job, expedition, repair, tier upgrade, or rarity upgrade. Selling, trading, and collecting for achievements are excluded from that definition. Catalog class names such as “consumable” or “equipment” do not themselves prove that an item can be used or equipped.

Categories below count each item once by its first matching production source; every additional source (including shops, tier upgrades, and salvage) appears inside its expandable row. Uses identify implemented requirements; they do not simulate progression or guarantee usefulness at your current level.
